title: Move prod to --moe-cache-auto with 220k KV (after a full 220k prefill)

concurrency.kv_pool: single shared 220032-token pool (num_pages 3438 x 64); requests share it via the page table, identical prefixes are deduplicated by the radix cache
concurrency.finding: distinct prompts collapse aggregate throughput (PCIe expert gather is shared); the identical-prompt n=2/n=4 wins were radix prefix sharing. 4x60k (>220k) is not rejected but serialised on page availability: no request gets a private 220k while others run.
concurrency.batched_vs_single_greedy: bs=2 output sha differs from bs=1 (6033d571 vs f8cb8d6f); greedy is not batch-invariant

cases.evidence: 217853 tokens, TTFT 224.15 s, no OOM; sustained 21.57 tok/s
sha1 f8cb8d6f5b7b identical to prod manual
shared 220k pool; distinct-prompt n=4 aggregate 1.5-4 tok/s

rollback_recipe: sudo cp /opt/FreeToken/.x299-backup/mtp-test.conf.before-45 /etc/systemd/system/freetoken.service.d/mtp-test.conf && sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart freetoken.service (restores --moe-cache-size 2600).
limitations: The 16k A/B baseline was re-measured on the current prod build (19.16/19.17); 07b had 18.44, so the gain is stated against the freshly measured 19.16.

max prefilled prompt was 217853 tokens (~99% of the 220032 declared max); 220032 exactly was not sent because prompt_tokens includes the chat template and the earlier 241402-token attempt was dropped.

Batched greedy is not bit-identical to single-request greedy (numerics), and distinct-prompt concurrency is net-negative on this PCIe-bound box; --max-running-requests 1 was chosen for the single-request goal.
Concurrency numbers used repeated/rotated doc text; real workloads may vary.
